_note: v2.4 plan 02 step 2, row 'persona change' (H18; scenario plan02 'requirements-refresh', persona half). No backend. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-02-persona-change.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'. NEEDS an install with at least two personas (it picks one that is not active; with fewer it fails at step 3 naming that, which is a precondition, not a product result). H18, re-verified 2026-09-24: selecting a persona runs setUserAvatar (personas.js:154-168), which emits PERSONA_CHANGED(avatar) (:167) after retriggerFirstMessageOnEmptyChat (:163; that reloads an UNTAINTED group chat, personas.js:1875-1882, so the fixture sends a line first: sendMessageAsUser taints the chat, script.js:5905, and the persona change is then a pure PERSONA_CHANGED with no reload behind it). /persona-set mode=lookup <name|avatar key> (personas.js:2823, setNameCallback :2408-2438) finds the persona and auto-selects it. ST restores a chat-locked persona in its own CHAT_CHANGED listener (loadPersonaForCurrentChat :1543, registered :3004), which is why the switch here is made inside the chat. The story's requirements name the persona that is NOT active, so it loads not-ready (evaluateRequirements reads ctx.name1, requirements.ts:7-28). The persona is then switched to the required one with no turn taken. Asserts: requirements read ready within 3 s of the switch (plan 02 section 8: PERSONA_CHANGED -> 250 ms debounce -> refresh). The original persona is put back and the dynamically built story removed from the library BEFORE the assertion, so a red run leaves the install as it found it (the story has to be built in-page because the persona name is the install's, so the runner's hash-scoped cleanup never sees it). EXPECTED RED on today's code: PERSONA_CHANGED is unsubscribed (grep src = 0) and requirements refresh only at commit, activate, load and rollback (runtimeManager.ts commitBoundary :266), so they stay not-ready until the next turn.

steps.send: I take the brass key from the hook.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const { user_avatar } = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); const personas = ctx.powerUserSettings?.personas ?? {}; const target = Object.entries(personas).find(([avatar, name]) => avatar !== user_avatar && typeof name === 'string' && name.trim() && name.trim().toLowerCase() !== String(ctx.name1).trim().toLowerCase() && !/[|{}]/.test(name)); if (!target) throw new Error(`precondition: this install needs a second persona with a different name (found ${Object.keys(personas).length} persona(s)); the fixture cannot run here`); if (!ctx.chatMetadata.tainted) throw new Error('the chat is not tainted after a sent line, so a persona change would reload it (H9) and this would test the reload, not PERSONA_CHANGED'); const story = { format: 2, id: 'v24-02-persona-change', title: 'v24-02 Persona Change', description: 'v2.4 plan 02 H18 fixture: requires a persona the chat does not have yet.', requirements: { personas: [target[1].trim()] }, qualities: [{ key: 'ready_flag', type: 'bool', source: 'extractor', rubric: 'Never set.' }], checkpoints: [{ id: 'start', name: 'Start', objective: 'Wait for the right persona.', type: 'anchor', start: true }], transitions: [], roster: [] }; globalThis.__v24Persona = { originalAvatar: user_avatar, originalName: ctx.name1, targetAvatar: target[0], targetName: target[1].trim(), storyId: story.id, readyAfter: null, restored: false, removed: false }; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.importStory(JSON.stringify(story)); return globalThis.__v24Persona;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.storyId !== globalThis.__v24Persona.storyId) throw new Error(`the persona story did not load: ${snapshot.storyId}`); const req = snapshot.requirements; if (req?.ready !== false || !(req.missingPersonas ?? []).includes(globalThis.__v24Persona.targetName)) throw new Error(`precondition: the story should load not-ready, missing ${globalThis.__v24Persona.targetName}: ${JSON.stringify(req)}`); globalThis.__v24Persona.boundary = rt.getEngineState()?.boundary ?? null; return { requirements: req };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const p = globalThis.__v24Persona; const seen = []; const handler = (avatar) => seen.push(avatar); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.PERSONA_CHANGED, handler); try { await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/persona-set mode=lookup ${p.targetAvatar}`); for (let i = 0; i < 30 && rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.ready !== true; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.PERSONA_CHANGED, handler); } p.personaChanged = seen; p.nameAfter = SillyTavern.getContext().name1; p.readyAfter = rt.getSnapshot().requirements ?? null; p.boundaryAfter = rt.getEngineState()?.boundary ?? null; return { personaChanged: seen, name1: p.nameAfter, requirements: p.readyAfter, boundaryBefore: p.boundary, boundaryAfter: p.boundaryAfter };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const p = globalThis.__v24Persona; await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions(`/persona-set mode=lookup ${p.originalAvatar}`); const personasModule = await import('/scripts/personas.js'); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && personasModule.user_avatar !== p.originalAvatar; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); p.restored = personasModule.user_avatar === p.originalAvatar; p.removed = await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.removeStory(p.storyId); ctx.saveSettingsDebounced(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return { restored: p.restored, removed: p.removed };

const p = globalThis.__v24Persona; if (!p.restored) throw new Error(`the original persona ${p.originalName} was not put back; restore it by hand`); if (!p.removed) throw new Error(`the fixture story ${p.storyId} was not removed from the library; remove it by hand`); if (!(p.personaChanged ?? []).includes(p.targetAvatar)) throw new Error(`H18: switching to ${p.targetName} emitted no PERSONA_CHANGED(${p.targetAvatar}): ${JSON.stringify(p.personaChanged)}`); if (p.nameAfter !== p.targetName) throw new Error(`the persona switch did not land: name1 is ${p.nameAfter}`); if (p.boundaryAfter !== p.boundary) throw new Error(`a boundary was committed during the switch (${p.boundary} -> ${p.boundaryAfter}), so this would not prove a refresh without a turn`); if (p.readyAfter?.ready !== true) throw new Error(`the requirements did not go green after switching to the required persona without a turn (plan 02 section 8, PERSONA_CHANGED): ${JSON.stringify(p.readyAfter)}`); return { ready: true };
